Analyze: are the skills and helpers worth keeping?

Date2026-11-26Scope11 skills and 4 helpers, each on a real task with and without it (Sonnet, 1 run per arm)Statusdone

Bottom line8 skills and all 4 helpers earn their place; ui-ux-pro-max, playwright and skill-creator gave the same result without them, so they are dropped. Skills cost about 6% more tokens, so judge them by result, not cost.

High powershell -c "git push" skipped the push ask

Problem
the guard unwrapped only -Command; PowerShell also accepts -c and every prefix, so the push ran with no prompt.
Fix
done: WRAPPERS accepts every -Command prefix; tests added.
If skipped
any agent could push by wrapping the command.
Where
hooks/guard.mjs

Medium the guard tests missed 2 discard commands

Problem
a clone with git checkout -f and git reset --keep removed from the guard passed all 44 tests.
Fix
done: both cases are in the ask list of guard.test.mjs.
If skipped
the next refactor can drop them unnoticed.
Where
hooks/guard.test.mjs

Medium 2 guard gaps remain open

Problem
echo x > .env (a write) and the Gmail MCP's trash_thread, label and forward are allowed.
Fix
add a write check for secret files and the missing MCP verbs, with tests.
If skipped
an agent can overwrite a secrets file or trash mail without a prompt.
Where
hooks/guard.mjs

tester, researcher, reviewer, challengerkeepreviewer found 2 of 2 seeded bugs with 21k tokens vs 52k for a plain agent; researcher 31k vs 53k for the same answer

Skills add about 6% tokens, less than the noise

With skills800 k tokens11 tasks, 720 sWithout755 k tokens669 s

Per pair the gap ranges from -18% (improve) to +24% (skill-creator), wider than the 6% mean, so one pair's token count decides nothing.

Helpers pay off only on long output

JobHelperInline in the main chat
node --test + vault checktester: 20k Haiku tokens, 34 s4.5 KB output, about 1.3k tokens, 10 s
where are skills and helpers countedresearcher: 25k tokens, judged 2 stale linesgit grep: 9 KB raw, no judgement

So the rule now sends commands with long output to tester and lets the main agent run short ones.

Evidence

Method: each arm was a fresh Sonnet agent with the same brief; the "with" arm read skills/<name>/SKILL.md first, the "without" arm was barred from all skill folders. Helper-only arms: tester and researcher against the same work run inline, reviewer and challenger against a plain agent. Agents could not start helpers, so skill steps that call one were done in place. The data run with the skill was stopped by the user.
